controls_preserved.codex: original frozen; entry/add restrictions including R14 unchanged
controls_preserved.dsh: original tracking; entry/add earnings-quality restrictions unchanged

new_research_assumptions.investment_mark_scope: All disclosed consolidated investments plus bank resources, paired with all fund LP debt; no claim of nonrecourse; no separate fund NAV added. Loans remain operating assets in fintech cash flows.
new_research_assumptions.investment_marks_date: 2026-06-30; unchanged midcase marks are a research hypothesis at 2026-11-08, not measured current NAV
new_research_assumptions.tax_reserve: Net reported DTL used as allocation proxy; gross DTL and zero are sensitivities, no unsupported tax refund
new_research_assumptions.operating_cash: One month cash operating costs about325 hundred-million CNY; base300, low400, high250; includes finance/subsidiary liquidity; all deposits additionally ring-fenced tested separately
new_research_assumptions.h2_cash_roll: July1-Nov8 operating/financing-income/working-capital/asset-value change excluding known share events. -60/base0/+60; base zero is net offset scenario, not absence of cash flows. Expense SBC retained as economic cost; additional issuance from July-Oct already in shares. Existing-debt principal settlement changes both cash and debt and is not an extra deduction.
new_research_assumptions.future_investment: Annual gross additions and working-capital change expressly deducted in FCFF. Existing intangible and construction payable deducted in bridge; no future payment of same asset in capex. Unincurred PP&E commitment included in future capex, investment commitment creates asset (not full loss).
new_research_assumptions.lease: Operating-cash-rent method: EBIT reduced by annualized (cash lease payment minus ROU DA), scaled with revenue; DA excludes ROU; existing lease liability not deducted; future recurring rent remains in EBIT. This is an assumed normalized rent path, not a claim all contracts renew at same price.
new_research_assumptions.sbc: Normal SBC retained in segment EBIT; not added back in FCFF, equivalent recurring cash compensation. No separate normal-SBC pricing penalty. Basic issued denominator maintained for original comparison; incremental award dilution is separately tested, not stacked automatically.
new_research_assumptions.fintech: Internet includes fintech. Loan assets are operating assets (not separately added to NAV); ΔNWC includes funding needs. Required liquidity included in reserve; deposit cash not presumed distributable. Exact finance sub cash/investment allocation remains uncertain, bounded by an all-deposit extra-ringfence sensitivity.
new_research_assumptions.capital_cost: CNY nominal WACC8.5/9.5/11%, not HK listing currency shortcut. Range combines low CNY debt costs with much larger equity business/competition premium; 9.5% is research assumption, not estimated CAPM. P1 operates at an explicit 12% unlevered operating hurdle and is not a promised 12% stock IRR.
new_research_assumptions.residual_price_risks: No automatic fixed price charges for unquantified market flows, ordinary costs already in FCFF, or high market implied terminal expectations. Independent legal/recall and capital shocks remain named sensitivities; all original nonprice controls remain.
new_research_assumptions.ev_coupling: 2027 revenue explicitly units*manufacturerASP+related services; gross margin minus R&D/sales/admin/SBC costs; costs grow in nominal CNY, not an independent margin guess. Base60万*22万元+50亿元=1370亿元, gross22%, opex310.5亿元, EBIT-9.1亿元; thereafter12% revenue and7% opex growth. Prior1050/-2% combination held only as original-comparison DCF.
